latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – provides an expert guide for editing Chinese texts to remove AI-generated traces.

- Identifies and explains 24+ common AI writing patterns (e.g., vague attributions, overuse of connectors, formulaic structures).
- Offers before/after rewriting examples for each pattern.
- Includes detailed “core rules,” practical checklists, and a scoring system for humanized text quality.
- Adapted to Chinese language and style, referencing the Wikipedia “Signs of AI writing” guide.
- Workflow supports editors/reviewers seeking to make texts sound more natural and human.
